scope.intent: Replace the Node monitor with layered Rust monitor and alerter daemons while preserving metrics schema v3 and adding first-phase alerting end to end.

appliedFixes: Added the immutable upgrade migration for unsilenced incident events and verified history preservation.
Made escalation delivery identities unique after silence restart epochs.
Converted referenced alert configuration deletions into controlled 409 conflicts.
Separated alert evaluation and SMTP delivery loops and closed acknowledgement and retry races.
Applied configured collector cadence to stale evaluation and hardened plaintext SMTP DNS handling.
Restored the declared Rust dependency direction by moving configuration value objects and runtime assembly.

testingGaps: A 24-hour CM5 soak and production resource/latency acceptance were not performed on macOS.
Production SMTP relay and certificate behavior requires target-environment acceptance.
residualRisks: Linux procfs and systemd collectors remain degraded on the macOS development host by design.
Operational CPU, RSS, restart continuity, and query latency targets remain release gates.

verification.runtimeApi: passed after restarting monitor and alerter against .zos/dev-root
verification.browser: passed at 1440, 820, 560, 390, and 320 px in light and dark themes with no console errors or document-level overflow
